title.description: The title of the form, used to describe the theme or purpose of the entire form, no more than 20 words.

questions.description: A list of questions, containing all the question items in the form that the user needs to answer.

items.description: A question item in the form, defining all the attributes and behaviors of a single question.

id.description: The unique identifier of the question, used to distinguish different questions in the form.

title.description: The description of the question, the text of the question displayed to the user.

type.description: The type of question, which determines the interaction mode and data collection mode of the question.

options.description: A list of options, used only when the type is radio (single choice) or checkbox (multiple choice), and is a required field.

items.description: Option item configuration, defining the specific options in a single-choice or multiple-choice question.

id.description: The unique identifier of the option, used to distinguish different options in the option list.

label.description: The display text of the option, the content of the option displayed to the user.

value.description: The value of the option, the actual value used for data processing and storage.

selected.description: Whether it is the default selected item, which controls the initial selected state of the option.

description.description: Option description information, providing detailed instructions or supplementary information for the option.

assets.description: A list of media resources, used only when the type is media (media selection), and is a required field.

items.description: Media resource configuration, defining the attributes and metadata of media files.

id.description: The unique identifier of the resource, used to distinguish different media files in the resource list.

name.description: The name of the resource, the display name of the media file.

type.description: The type of resource, specifying the category of the media file.

url.description: The URL of the resource, the access address of the media file.

size.description: The size of the file, the file size in bytes.

mimeType.description: MIME type, the standard media type identifier.

thumbnailUrl.description: The URL of the thumbnail, the address of the small-sized picture for preview (applicable to pictures and videos).

description.description: Resource description, detailed instructions or remarks for the media file.

textValue.description: The default text value, available only when the type is text (text input), and is an optional field.

placeholder.description: Input prompt text, available only when the type is text (text input), and is an optional field.
